name: porter-blast-radius
description: Read-only blast-radius and emergent-use-case analysis for Porter's multi-repo coupling: an MCP connector that builds a coupling model from local repos and computes what a change reaches, plus a skill for when to use it.

extra_roots.title: Extra roots
extra_roots.description: More directories the connector may read models and repositories from, separated by ':' (';' on Windows). The project directory is always allowed.

atlas_db.title: Atlas database
atlas_db.description: Optional path to a kgirl Atlas database (usually ~/.kgirl/atlas.db). The connector opens only this file, read-only.
